116-year-old woman walks to Tirumala for temple darshan

A 116-year-old woman named Navaneethamma undertook a journey on foot to Tirumala to visit the temple. Her trek covered 9 kilometers and involved climbing 3,550 steps. The Tirumala Tirupati Devasthanams (TTD) arranged a special VIP darshan for her. Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister Chandrababu Naidu reacted to a video of her journey, stating that true devotion transcends age.
